plan.notes: Source: https://acu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Organizational-Leadership-BS.pdf (official ACU Online degree plan, 2026-2027 Academic Year, College of Leadership and Professional Studies, 100% ONLINE, 120 credit hours). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Caveats: (1) The PDF marks LEAD 211, LEAD 214, LEAD 343, LEAD 386, and LEAD 411 with '*Identifies a course that is pending university approval.' (2) PDF arithmetic is inconsistent: 16 major courses (48 hrs) + 56 hrs gen-ed + 25 hrs electives = 129, not 120. Modeled with electives = 16 hrs so the plan sums to the official 120-hour total (48+56+16=120). (3) LEAD 491 prerequisite per PDF: 'majors only; LEAD 386' (LEAD 386 placed in an earlier semester). (4) Semester placement is a recommended sequence; the PDF does not publish a semester-by-semester layout.
